post.description: Attach a LoRA adapter model to a serving_mode='multi_adapter' deployment under a stable public alias (serve_name). The fleet's replicas download and load the adapter asynchronously: the attachment starts in status 'attaching' and becomes 'active' once every serving replica reports it loaded (poll the list endpoint).

delete.description: Remove an adapter attachment. When no serving replica still holds the adapter it is deleted immediately (deleted=true); otherwise the attachment enters status 'detaching' (deleted=false) and is garbage-collected once every replica has unloaded it.

200.description: Detach result: {serve_name, deleted} — deleted=true when removed immediately, else deleted=false with status 'detaching'

patch.summary: Flip an adapter to a new version
patch.description: Point an attached alias at a new adapter model with zero downtime. The new version is staged alongside the current one; the alias cuts over atomically only once EVERY serving replica reports the new version loaded. Until then the call answers 409 'not yet converged' — retry the identical PATCH until it succeeds; the current version keeps serving throughout.

200.description: The cutover completed: the alias now serves the new model at version+1, status 'active'

400.description: Not a multi_adapter deployment, the model is not an attachable adapter, or the alias already serves this model

404.description: Deployment, adapter, or model not found, or not owned by the caller

409.description: Staged but not yet converged (retry until every replica reports the new version loaded), or the adapter changed concurrently

post.description: Point the alias back at the previously served adapter model (previous_model_id) under a fresh version. Status returns to 'attaching' until every serving replica reports the rollback target loaded — usually immediate when the old weights are still resident, otherwise after a re-download.

200.description: The alias now serves the previous model at version+1, status 'attaching' until the fleet converges

post.description: Retire one replica of a serving deployment. Default mode shrinks the fleet by one (the drained box is not replaced); pass replace=true to recycle the box in place — the reconciler launches a replacement so capacity is unchanged. A replica already taking traffic finishes its in-flight requests before the box is terminated (bounded by the drain timeout); a replica still booting is cancelled outright.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description:
Recycle mode: retire this replica WITHOUT shrinking the fleet. The
desired count is untouched, so the reconciler launches a replacement
box (a draining replica no longer counts as live).

409.description: Deployment is not serving, the replica is already draining/stopped/failed, or the drain would shrink the fleet below its floor / drop the last serving replica (use replace=true)

serve_name.description:
Public routing alias for the adapter: 1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._-].
Requests to the deployment addressed with this model name are served
by the adapter. Must not collide with the deployment's base alias.

model_id.description:
ID of a ready custom model with artifact_type='adapter' whose
base_model matches the deployment's base model.

ID of the adapter model to flip the alias to. Same constraints as
attach: owned, ready, artifact_type='adapter', matching base model.

AdapterReplicaState.description: Per-replica load state for one internal_name, rolled up into the GET list.

state.description:
downloading | loading | loaded | failed — or "missing" when the
replica's last report doesn't mention this internal_name at all.

error.description: Replica-reported error detail, present when state='failed'.

AdapterResponse.description: A LoRA adapter attached to a multi_adapter deployment.

deployment_id.description: The deployment (fleet) this adapter is attached to.

serve_name.description: Public routing alias the adapter serves under.

model_id.description: The custom model currently served under this alias.

version.description: Monotonic version counter; incremented on every flip/rollback.

status.description:
attaching | active | detaching. 'active' means every serving replica
reports the current version loaded.

previous_model_id.description: The previously served model, if any — the rollback target.

pending_model_id.description: Mid-flip only: the staged new version awaiting fleet convergence.

pending_internal_name.description: Mid-flip only: the staged version's internal name.

replicas.description: Per-serving-replica load state for the CURRENT internal_name.

path.description:
Path relative to the checkpoint root (e.g. "adapter_model.safetensors",
"tokenizer.json").

url.description: Presigned GET URL for this file (expires in 1h).

operation.description:
"serve" or "train". A serving runtime cannot be used for training and
vice versa; that is a platform validation rather than a matrix warning.

model.description:
Hugging Face model ID or a saved-model identifier. Exact model ID is
preferred; model revision is carried for future exact-revision profiles.

runtime_id.description:
Optional caller preference among the platform-approved runtime IDs from
GET /v1/compatibility/runtimes. An unknown ID is reported as a
non-overridable validation error, not silently treated as a custom image.

email.description:
Server-injected display email for the authenticated user. Set by the web
proxy from the signed-in Clerk session (never trusted from a browser
body). Absent for keys minted outside the proxy (SDK, CI). When present,
it upserts `users.email` so `/v1/me` and the CLI can show the account.

workspace_id.description:
Workspace the key is scoped to (workspaces design). Stamped by the web
proxy from the active Clerk org, or passed explicitly by SDK callers.
Absent / equal to the caller's own id => a personal key. Validated
server-side at mint: a workspace the caller is not a member of is
rejected, so the stamp is a convenience, never an authority.

key.description: Plaintext key returned ONCE on creation. Save it immediately.

CreateModelRequest.description:
Generic create body. `source.type` selects the ingress path; Phase 1 accepts
only training_job (huggingface/upload return 501).

replace_name.description:
Apply `name` to an already-saved model on a repeat save (idempotent save
otherwise leaves the original name untouched).

artifact.description:
Which artifact to save from the source job: "full" (default, the
standalone checkpoint) or "adapter" (LoRA jobs only — stores the PEFT
adapter dir as-is, without merging; the row records the job's base
model, VS-405).

event_types.description:
Event types to receive (e.g. ["deployment.serving", "job.completed"]).
Omit or pass [] to subscribe to all events.

CustomScriptConfig.description:
The BYO-script payload. Persisted verbatim as TrainingJob.script_config_json
and read back by the worker launch path (forward contract).

engine.description: Inference engine: "vllm" (default) or "max" (Modular MAX). Omitted => vllm.

num_replicas.description:
VS-341: number of GPU-box replicas to launch. Omitted => 1, which is
byte-for-byte today's single-box behavior. Validated 1..=8 at create.
Sugar for min_replicas == max_replicas == N (the CLI --replicas flag).

min_replicas.description:
Scaling foundation (§10): replica-count bounds. min == max => fixed N
(autoscaling off — there is no boolean flag). Omitted => both default to
num_replicas (fixed N). min = 0 arms scale-to-zero (VS-313): the fleet
parks after the idle window and wakes on the next request.

concurrency_target.description:
Per-replica concurrency setpoint the (VS-342) autoscaler targets:
desired = ceil(total_ongoing / concurrency_target), clamped to
[min_replicas, max_replicas]. Stored as target_ongoing_requests.
Omitted => 8 (throughput-biased; lower it for latency-sensitive chat).

scale_to_zero_window_seconds.description:
VS-313: idle seconds before a min_replicas=0 deployment parks
(scaled_to_zero). Omitted => 3600. Floor 300 (Fireworks' convention).

idle_delete_after_days.description:
VS-313: optional GC — a deployment parked at zero with no traffic for
this many days goes terminal (stopped). Omitted => kept forever.

cache.description:
HF cache-through (source=huggingface only): also save the downloaded
snapshot to the caller's model library so later deploys of this repo
start from S3 instead of the HF hub. Best-effort — a failed upload
never affects this deployment. Omitted => no caching.

vllm_extra_args.description:
VS-370: extra vLLM CLI flags appended verbatim to the engine command
(argv list, e.g. ["--speculative-config", "{...}", "--kv-cache-dtype",
"fp8"]). vllm engine only. Flags the platform owns (--model, --port,
--host, --api-key, --served-model-name) are rejected at create.

vllm_image.description:
VS-426: explicit vLLM serving image (e.g. "vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1")
for architectures newer than the platform default vLLM. Official
upstream images only (vllm/vllm-openai[-rocm]:<tag>). vllm engine only.
Forces the docker launcher on every provider, including AWS. Omitted =>
platform default.

startup_profiling.description:
Opt-in vLLM startup diagnostics: the serving agent exports
VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG + VLLM_GC_DEBUG=1 to the engine, records
startup phase timings, and reports them on the first healthy heartbeat
(or in the failure detail with a deeper stderr tail). Default false —
diagnostic logging slows inference, so use for diagnosis launches, not
steady customer traffic.

trace_bodies.description:
Request traces: capture this deployment's chat request/response bodies
and make them queryable via /v1/deployments/{id}/traces. Default false
(privacy: enabling stores end-user prompt/completion content, retained
per trace_retention). Requires the traces feature; billed per 1k traces
beyond the monthly free allowance.

trace_retention.description:
Trace retention class: omitted/null = "base" (14-day retention, base
rate), "extended" = 400-day retention at the extended rate. Only
meaningful with trace_bodies=true.

gpu_utilization.description:
VS-380: mean GPU utilization percent (0-100) across replicas reporting
in the bucket; null when no replica reported GPU telemetry. Debugging
metric — scale on requests_waiting + kv_cache_usage.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: VS-380: summed GPU memory in use (bytes) across reporting replicas.

replica_id.description:
Set when the response is scoped to one replica (?replica_id=); absent
for deployment-wide scope.

Set when the response is scoped to one replica (?replica_id=); absent
for deployment-wide scope.

gpu_utilization.description: VS-380: this replica's latest GPU utilization percent in the bucket.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: VS-380: this replica's latest GPU memory in use (bytes) in the bucket.

replica_id.description: `legacy` represents pre-replica samples recorded directly on a deployment.

DeploymentReplicaResponse.description:
A frontend-safe view of a serving replica. The endpoint itself remains
private to the control plane; the topology only needs to know whether an
endpoint is currently routable.

region.description:
Cloud region the box launched into; None when the provider path does
not expose it (pre-placement rows, non-AWS providers).

instance_type.description:
Provider instance shape (e.g. an EC2 instance type); None when the
launch path does not resolve it in the control plane.

cost_per_box_hour_usd.description:
Per-box hourly rate: the rate snapshotted on the replica at launch,
else the deployment's per-box fallback.

gpu_utilization.description:
VS-380 GPU hardware snapshot (NVML, from the last heartbeat). All
fields absent when the worker did not report telemetry. Debugging
metric only: scale on requests_waiting + kv_cache_usage, not this
(nvidia-smi-style utilization measures kernel residency, not pressure).
Mean utilization percent (0-100) across the replica's GPUs.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory in use across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_memory_total_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory capacity across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_power_w.description: Summed power draw across the replica's GPUs, watts.

gpu_temperature_c.description: Hottest GPU on the replica, degrees C.

gpu_devices.description: Per-GPU readings behind the aggregates above.

latency_ms.description: Backward-compatible alias for e2e_latency_ms on newly recorded requests.

source_model_id.description:
For a custom_model deployment, the saved model this was created from
(provenance). Also set on a source=huggingface deployment that took the
transparent cache hit (serving from the caller's cached S3 copy). Null
otherwise.

cache_model_id.description:
HF cache-through: the library model (status importing) this
deployment's box is uploading its snapshot into. Null unless the
deployment was created with cache=true and the upload is the one this
boot owns.

byoc_repo.description:
BYOC (provider='huggingface'): the HF hub repository this endpoint
serves under the owner's account. Null for every non-BYOC deployment.

vllm_extra_args.description:
VS-370: the extra vLLM CLI flags this deployment was created with
(argv list). Null unless supplied at create.

vllm_image.description:
VS-426: the explicit vLLM serving image this deployment was created
with. Null unless supplied at create.

startup_profiling.description: Whether this deployment was created with startup diagnostics on.

trace_bodies.description: Whether request/response bodies are captured as traces.

trace_retention.description:
Trace retention class ("extended" or null = base). Null unless
trace_bodies deployments set it.

startup_metrics.description:
Startup phase timings reported by a profiled deployment's first healthy
heartbeat (seconds: model_sync_s, engine_start_to_healthy_s, total_s).
Null unless startup_profiling was set and the engine reached healthy.

num_replicas.description:
VS-341: DESIRED replica count (GPU boxes) behind this deployment. The
observed count is ready_replicas — the K8s spec/status split; the CLI
renders "ready/desired" (e.g. 2/3).

ready_replicas.description: Observed: replicas currently serving with a routable endpoint.

min_replicas.description: Replica-count bounds. min == max => fixed N (autoscaling off).

scale_to_zero_window_seconds.description: VS-313: idle window before a min=0 deployment parks (None = 3600s).

idle_delete_after_days.description: VS-313: parked-deployment GC in days (None = kept forever).

DeploymentUpdate.description:
PATCH /v1/deployments/{id} — the mutable-field whitelist. Everything else on
a deployment (model, source, gpu, engine, provider) is immutable, matching
every surveyed platform (Fireworks/Baseten/K8s): changing those is a new
deployment. deny_unknown_fields makes an attempt to PATCH an immutable field
a validation error instead of a silent no-op.

Desired-state semantics: the PATCH validates + persists the new bounds and
returns immediately (desired + observed); the reconciler's scaling pass
converges the replica fleet asynchronously.

DepsSpec.description:
Dependency layer for a custom_script job. The worker installs these inside the
container before the entrypoint (uv pip). `kind` is "requirements" | "uv_lock"
| "none"; `content` is the file text for the first two.

GpuAvailabilityRow.description:
One availability row. Mirrors the transport `AvailabilityRow` JSON (SA-3); the
control plane passes it through verbatim. Optional fields are provider-shaped,
so `serde(default)` lets a row the transport omitted a field on still parse.

gpu_count.description: GPUs per launchable unit (Hot Aisle VM cards; AWS whole-node GPU count).

status.description:
"AVAILABLE" (Hot Aisle live qty>0), "OFFERED" (AWS catalog + spot proxy),
or "UNAVAILABLE".

available.description: Hot Aisle live count of launchable VMs of this shape (absent for AWS).

spot_score.description: AWS Spot placement score 1–10 proxy (absent for Hot Aisle).

price_per_hr.description:
Per-GPU USD/hr for this shape. On the wire from the transport this is the
provider's RAW published rate; before returning to the caller the endpoint
marks it up by the per-provider markup (VS-344) so it matches the customer
price on /v1/cost/rates and never leaks the raw margin.

checked_at.description:
When the returned rows were probed. Null only when no snapshot exists
yet AND a refresh is already in flight (retry shortly).

age_seconds.description: Seconds since `checked_at` (server clock), for staleness at a glance.

refreshed.description:
True when THIS request ran the probe (cache was stale and the lock was
free). False = served from cache.

refreshing.description:
True when another request's probe is in flight; the rows below are the
previous snapshot. Poll again in a few seconds for the fresh one.

GpuCatalogRow.description: One catalog row: a (provider, workload, gpu_type) offering.

node_counts.description:
Orderable GPUs-per-node counts for this shape (e.g. [8] for AWS
A100/H100 — whole nodes only; [1, 8] for DigitalOcean H100 training).

status.description:
"available" (orderable now) or "coming_soon" (wired but behind a
feature flag — a create 400s until the flag flips).

usd_per_gpu_hr.description:
Customer $/GPU-hr (marked up, matching /v1/cost/rates). Absent until
the provider's rate is seeded — never a fabricated 0.

GpuDeviceMetrics.description:
One GPU's NVML reading from the replica's last heartbeat (VS-380). Every
field except `index` is individually best-effort (some GPUs/VMs withhold
power or temperature).

utilization.description:
Utilization percent (0-100) as NVML reports it: the share of time a
kernel was resident, not how much of the chip it used.

GpuInfo.description:
Pydantic `GPUInfo` (with `type` field). Rust uses `gpu_type` internally
but serializes as "type" for JSON parity.

harness_protocol.description:
Which protocol the harness speaks: "openai" (OpenAI SDK / LangChain /
OpenAI Agents SDK) or "anthropic" (Claude Agent SDK).

max_turns.description:
Turn budget hint passed to the harness (VERI_MAX_TURNS). Higher than
grpo_agentic's 5: agent SDKs chain many tool calls per task.

harness_timeout_s.description: Wall-clock budget for ONE harness invocation (one rollout).

max_parallel_rollouts.description: Concurrent harness invocations per training step.

vllm_gpu_memory_utilization.description:
vLLM memory fraction for the colocated policy server; the rest stays
free for training. Lower than a serving deployment's 0.9 by design.

trajectory_retention_days.description:
Days raw trajectories stay in S3 before the retention sweep removes
them (the Postgres index rows are deleted too). None = keep forever.

HarnessGrpoHyperparameters.description:
Harness-in-the-loop GRPO (VS-372): the user's own agent harness (Claude
Agent SDK / LangChain / OpenAI Agents SDK) drives multi-turn rollouts
against the in-training policy. Shares GRPO's core knobs; the
harness-specific ones tune rollout execution and the colocated vLLM
policy server. The harness code itself arrives via the job's `script`
payload (same shape as custom_script).

repo.description:
Target repo as "namespace/name". Created on first push (honoring
`private`); re-exports to an existing repo upload over it.

private.description:
Repo visibility. Defaults to private — a public push is an explicit
choice, never an accident.

hf_repo_url.description: Set on completion; the pushed repo's URL.

HfPushConfig.description:
Opt-in end-of-training push of the trained artifact to the user's Hugging
Face account. Requires a connected HF integration
(PUT /v1/settings/integrations/huggingface); the token itself never rides
in the job config — the worker exchanges its callback_token for it at
runtime, exactly like W&B.

artifact.description:
Which artifact to push: "merged" (full standalone weights) or
"adapter" (LoRA adapter only; requires lora_rank on the job).

private.description:
Repo visibility. Defaults to private — a public push is an explicit
choice, never an accident.

token.description:
Hugging Face access token (huggingface.co/settings/tokens) with write
scope. Stored encrypted at rest; never returned by the API.

username.description: The HF account the token belongs to (from whoami at connect time).

email.description:
Display email, synced from the signed-in session when a key was minted.
Null until the user mints a key through the web proxy.

plan.description: Reserved for future billing plan surfacing.

org_id.description:
The active workspace when the caller is scoped to a team workspace
(workspaces design); null for personal scope. The field predates
workspaces (reserved as "org_id"), so the name stays for SDK
compatibility.

download_url.description:
Presigned URL of the primary weights file. Legacy single-file field:
an HF checkpoint is a directory, so downloading only this yields an
unloadable model — use `files` instead.

files.description:
Every file of the final HF checkpoint. Download all of them, preserving
paths, to get a directory loadable with `from_pretrained`.

base_model.description:
The base checkpoint this model derives from. For artifact_type
'adapter' this names the model the adapter must be served on top of.

artifact_type.description:
'full' (standalone checkpoint) | 'adapter' (LoRA adapter; only
attachable to a multi_adapter deployment).

items.description:
A frontend-safe view of a serving replica. The endpoint itself remains
private to the control plane; the topology only needs to know whether an
endpoint is currently routable.

region.description:
Cloud region the box launched into; None when the provider path does
not expose it (pre-placement rows, non-AWS providers).

instance_type.description:
Provider instance shape (e.g. an EC2 instance type); None when the
launch path does not resolve it in the control plane.

cost_per_box_hour_usd.description:
Per-box hourly rate: the rate snapshotted on the replica at launch,
else the deployment's per-box fallback.

gpu_utilization.description:
VS-380 GPU hardware snapshot (NVML, from the last heartbeat). All
fields absent when the worker did not report telemetry. Debugging
metric only: scale on requests_waiting + kv_cache_usage, not this
(nvidia-smi-style utilization measures kernel residency, not pressure).
Mean utilization percent (0-100) across the replica's GPUs.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory in use across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_memory_total_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory capacity across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_power_w.description: Summed power draw across the replica's GPUs, watts.

gpu_temperature_c.description: Hottest GPU on the replica, degrees C.

gpu_devices.description: Per-GPU readings behind the aggregates above.

latency_ms.description: Backward-compatible alias for e2e_latency_ms on newly recorded requests.

source_model_id.description:
For a custom_model deployment, the saved model this was created from
(provenance). Also set on a source=huggingface deployment that took the
transparent cache hit (serving from the caller's cached S3 copy). Null
otherwise.

cache_model_id.description:
HF cache-through: the library model (status importing) this
deployment's box is uploading its snapshot into. Null unless the
deployment was created with cache=true and the upload is the one this
boot owns.

byoc_repo.description:
BYOC (provider='huggingface'): the HF hub repository this endpoint
serves under the owner's account. Null for every non-BYOC deployment.

vllm_extra_args.description:
VS-370: the extra vLLM CLI flags this deployment was created with
(argv list). Null unless supplied at create.

vllm_image.description:
VS-426: the explicit vLLM serving image this deployment was created
with. Null unless supplied at create.

startup_profiling.description: Whether this deployment was created with startup diagnostics on.

trace_bodies.description: Whether request/response bodies are captured as traces.

trace_retention.description:
Trace retention class ("extended" or null = base). Null unless
trace_bodies deployments set it.

startup_metrics.description:
Startup phase timings reported by a profiled deployment's first healthy
heartbeat (seconds: model_sync_s, engine_start_to_healthy_s, total_s).
Null unless startup_profiling was set and the engine reached healthy.

num_replicas.description:
VS-341: DESIRED replica count (GPU boxes) behind this deployment. The
observed count is ready_replicas — the K8s spec/status split; the CLI
renders "ready/desired" (e.g. 2/3).

ready_replicas.description: Observed: replicas currently serving with a routable endpoint.

min_replicas.description: Replica-count bounds. min == max => fixed N (autoscaling off).

scale_to_zero_window_seconds.description: VS-313: idle window before a min=0 deployment parks (None = 3600s).

idle_delete_after_days.description: VS-313: parked-deployment GC in days (None = kept forever).

base_model.description:
The base checkpoint this model derives from. For artifact_type
'adapter' this names the model the adapter must be served on top of.

artifact_type.description:
'full' (standalone checkpoint) | 'adapter' (LoRA adapter; only
attachable to a multi_adapter deployment).

reward_count.description:
How many inline reward sources the job was submitted with (null for
reward-free methods). Sources are viewable per job via the dashboard.

oneOf.description: The hf_push request echoed back (null when the job didn't opt in).

hf_repo_url.description:
Set after a successful end-of-training push to Hugging Face; the
pushed repo's URL (mirrors wandb_run_url).

secret.description:
Full "whsec_..." signing secret on create ONLY; masked on every other
read (use GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/secret to retrieve it again).

event_types.description: Empty = subscribed to all event types.

disabled_at.description:
Set when the endpoint is disabled (manually or automatically after 50
consecutive delivery failures). Disabled endpoints receive no events.

PlatformValidation.description:
Errors in this field are platform safety/provenance checks. A user may
choose outside matrix guidance, but may not select an unapproved runtime ID
or use a runtime for the wrong operation.

vllm_extra_args.description:
These values are recommendations only in phase one. The current
deployment payload stays untouched, including legacy `vllm_image`.

gpu_candidates.description:
Shapes the reviewed profile was written for. This is advisory only:
capacity and final memory feasibility are separate checks.

default.description: True for the home region used when a job specifies no region.

launch_enabled.description:
Whether training jobs may launch into this region right now. A listed
region with `launch_enabled: false` is coming soon (visible while its
substrate is provisioned); submit rejects it. VS-257 Phase 1.

default.description: The default/home region name (echoed for convenience / CLI highlighting).

RegisterRequest.description: Legacy flat body for POST /v1/models/register (compat alias).

id.description:
Stable platform identifier. Later create endpoints will accept this ID,
never a caller supplied registry/image string.

launcher.description:
"module" is the AMI-provided default; "docker" is an approved official
image. Image digests are intentionally deferred until Veri mirrors the
images it operates (the current legacy vllm_image contract accepts tags).

reward_source.description:
Inline reward source (Python text, TRL signature). Attached to the job
at submit and stored job-scoped; there is no stored reward resource.

oneOf.description:
Push the trained artifact to your Hugging Face account when the job
completes. Requires a connected HF integration
(PUT /v1/settings/integrations/huggingface). Validated at submit:
managed grpo/grpo_harness/sft_text/dpo jobs only, and
artifact="adapter" needs hyperparameters.lora_rank. On success the job
carries hf_repo_url.

reward_count.description:
How many inline reward sources the job was submitted with (null for
reward-free methods). Sources are viewable per job via the dashboard.

oneOf.description: The hf_push request echoed back (null when the job didn't opt in).

hf_repo_url.description:
Set after a successful end-of-training push to Hugging Face; the
pushed repo's URL (mirrors wandb_run_url).

enabled.description:
true re-enables an auto-disabled endpoint (clears disabled_at and the
consecutive-failure counter); false disables it.

api_key.description:
W&B API key (from wandb.ai/authorize). Stored encrypted at rest; never
returned by the API.

project.description: Default W&B project training runs log to. Defaults to "veri-training".

secret.description:
Full "whsec_..." signing secret on create ONLY; masked on every other
read (use GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/secret to retrieve it again).

event_types.description: Empty = subscribed to all event types.

disabled_at.description:
Set when the endpoint is disabled (manually or automatically after 50
consecutive delivery failures). Disabled endpoints receive no events.

event_id.description: The webhook.test event id; arrives as the webhook-id header.

bearerAuth.description: API key with the `vk_` prefix. Create one from the dashboard.
